description: The figure is a two-level donut (ring) pie chart illustrating win rates (%) for empathetic responses, comparing GPT‑4o against two fine-tuned models across two separate matchups. Each ring contains 2 slices, for a total of 4 displayed segments across the full chart. In the outer ring, LLaMA is shown as a large light-blue slice at approximately 80.4%, and GPT‑4o as a smaller darker-blue slice at approximately 19.6%; both values are written outside the ring with leader lines. In the inner ring, Mistral is shown as a large very light beige slice at approximately 88.0%, and GPT‑4o as a smaller dark red/maroon slice at approximately 12.0%, again labeled outside with leader lines. The center of the donut contains the text “Win rate (%)”; there is no separate legend, the percentages are not printed inside slices, and no slices appear exploded or otherwise visually emphasized beyond color and ring placement.
